text:
alice: Heads-up — hit a reproducible duplication when using the async Python client with timeouts + retries. Noticed on 0.9.3.

alice: Repro gist (trimmed):
```python
from uuid import uuid4
from redwood import RedwoodAsyncClient

client = RedwoodAsyncClient(api_key='...', timeout=2)

async def create():
    idemp = str(uuid4())
    await client.post('/v1/objects', json={"name": "t"}, headers={"Idempotency-Key": idemp}, retry_policy={"max_retries": 3, "backoff_factor": 0.3})
```

alice: Sequence seen in logs: server responded 201, client read timed out, client retried and server created a second resource -> duplicate. I expected either no retry for non-idempotent by default or that we preserve Idempotency-Key on replay.

ben: Which SDK variant? async vs sync differences were changed recently around retry plumbing.

alice: async 0.9.3. Raw traces: 
OUT: POST /v1/objects 201 id=req_A headers:{Idempotency-Key: x}
OUT: read timeout waiting for response
OUT: retry #1 -> POST /v1/objects -> 201 id=req_B headers:{}

carla: Two things to check: 1) async client didn't auto-inject Idempotency-Key for POSTs like the sync client (we debated that earlier), 2) Type handling: async constructor's retry_policy is typed as RetryPolicy | None and we accept a dict at call-sites; I suspect dicts are being passed through but later code does isinstance(retry_policy, RetryPolicy) and skips proper backoff, causing immediate retries. Also headers may not be copied when the request is replayed.

carla: Workaround: construct RetryPolicy explicitly or add header yourself. Example:
```python
from redwood.retry import RetryPolicy
policy = RetryPolicy(max_retries=3, backoff_factor=0.5)
await client.post(..., retry_policy=policy)
```

alice: Confirmed workaround prevents the duplicate in my local flakey tests. I'll open an issue and a PR to coerce dicts to RetryPolicy and to preserve headers across replay.

b en: Add a unit test that simulates partial socket close / read-timeout + 5xx path to ensure replay uses same headers and backoff timings. Also include changelog entry — this could hit production customers.

carla: For typing, add constructor signature retry_policy: RetryPolicy | dict | None and a helper to coerce dict -> RetryPolicy at runtime. Avoid using Any.

alice: Filing issue + PR now, assigning to @ben for review.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch alice/async-replay-fix (jobs: unit, lint)

ci-bot: unit tests started (job id 4930)

ben: If CI looks good we should ship a patch release. Also add a short Quickstart note about idempotency behavior for async clients until release is cut.

alice: Will update Quickstart and include test matrix for sync/async parity. Thanks :thumbsup:
